messages:
devon: starting canary for sparrow-lite int4 onboarding. seeing streaming tool_call array fragments incorrectly joined; raw fragments below.

 devon: --frag1--
 {"output":[{"tool_call":{"name":"search","arguments":"{\"q\":\"widget\"}"}}
 --frag2--
 , {"tool_call":{"name":"format","arguments":"{\"fmt\":\"short\"}"}}]

 devon: stitcher sometimes produces an extra comma when concatenating fragments -> host parse fails. non-streaming ok. parse_fail rose 0.6% -> 3.1% after enabling int4 microbatching.

 ops-bot: canary:job="sparrow-lite-int4-2026-03-22" parse_fail=0.031 rps=600 p50_ms=90

 linh: could be tokenizer chunking or runtime chunk boundaries. please attach token idx ranges.

 devon: chunks tokens [0..18] and [19..34], mostly ascii; boundary contains leading comma in frag2.

 mike: runtime stitcher does a join(',') naive concat. I'll add trimming of leading/trailing commas and an NDJSON opt-in header.

 ana: mitigation: NDJSON or sentinel framing. NDJSON minimal. also increase parse-retry budget as short term band-aid.

 devon: quick test: flushed prefix cache at tool_call boundaries for canary; parse_fail dropped to 0.25% but p50 rose ~7ms.

 ops-bot: canary:job="sparrow-lite-int4-flush" parse_fail=0.0025 p50_ms=97 rps=595

 sara: add regression test that simulates random mid-json splits, metric toolcall_fragmentation_count, and alert on >1% parse_fail.

 mike: will open PR for stitcher hardening + NDJSON header. will include unit test that reproduces comma-boundary bug.

 devon: eval-id=eval-2026-03-22-9182. linh to check tokenizer hypotheses. keeping flush mitigation until PR lands. target roll to 20% in 12h if parse_fail <0.5% and latency reg <10ms.

 ana: ack :thumbsup:

 mike: PR posted shortly, pinging this thread when live.

 devon: thanks all, filing follow-ups in ticket.
